print_setup: PLA; 0.4 mm nozzle; 0.2 mm layers; 4-6 walls. Orient spigot down; inspect overhangs/supports in slicer. No G-code generated.

cfd_scope: CFD resolves outlet patches and external flow only. Internal loft separation/loss/velocity uniformity not resolved.
pressure_scope: Atmospheric exhaust flow body only. Not a compressed-air pressure component.
